title: Show the active member and server in the header
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · See who I am and why my connection needs attention.

**Expected behaviour** · Place clickable username, connection state and local time together. Open Profile from the username menu. Show backend address/version, retry and session recovery in the connection panel.

**Scope boundary** · Profile shows the single active member’s name and role.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-030

**Depends on** · WI-028, WI-030

**Verify** · Test expiry against a ready server and separately stop the backend. Check menu focus, Escape and long usernames at narrow width.

**Effort basis** · Existing identity and status APIs with bounded UI states.
evidence: Header shows local time, connection chip, username menu and Settings. Revoking a session produced `Reconnect` plus `Your session expired. Connect again to continue.` at the unchanged route; stopping the server produced `Server offline` and the restart instruction. The username menu marks the active profile and Escape returns focus to the trigger. `alexandra-montgomery` truncates to `alexandr...` at 320 px with the full name in title and menu; no horizontal overflow. Evidence: qa/sprint-2/WI-031/.
